{{Top|leg}}
'''Flash-clear''', or '''flash-erase''', was the term given to the act of completely wiping information from a [[Computer/Legends|computer's]] memory without any chance of recovering it. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]] initiated [[Omega order five]], which flash-cleared the computers in his [[Imperial Government Complex|headquarters]] during the [[Battle of Kal'Shebbol]]. As a result, the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] lost vast amounts of data including maps of the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]], and all of Sarne's documents and files.
